description: This file defines a React custom hook 'useProjectCost' that fetches and formats the aggregated cost of a project from a backend API. It manages state for data, loading, and error, and provides a method to refetch data. It also formats the cost using Intl.NumberFormat.

methods.name: useProjectCost
methods.description: A React hook that fetches and returns the project's cost data, loading state, error, a refetch function, and a formatted cost string.
